text: Acceptance 14 (threads): every reply sent from the thread panel is shown TWICE. Repro (michal, #general, thread of msg 1): type reply, Enter -> DOM #th-msgs [data-msg] = [1,2,3,24,24]; second reply -> [...,26,26]; server GET /api/messages/1/thread has 24 and 26 once. Cause: submit() pushes the POST result into state.threadMsgs after the SSE echo (zdarzenia-sse.js:157-159) already pushed it; no dedupe by id. Fix: findIndex before push (as SSE does) or drop the push and rely on the echo.
